items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: So he said, well, I'm going to show you some chords on it. And he used to show me some chords on it while they were, in between, while they were playing.

ctx.x: Well, that's how I come to learn, by watching other fellas play. There used to be a fella by the name of Willie Bontong used to play with Chris Kelly long years ago, and he was a good guitar player. And wherever they played up, I used to go stand up by the bandstand and watch him. So he told me one time, he said, you like that instrument there? I said, yeah. So he said, well, I'm going to show you some chords on it. And he used to show me some chords on it while they were, in between, while they were playing. So…
